item.title: SHEMM Coach
item.description: Today, let's talk Sleep. You've stacked good wind-down tools tonight — relaxation practice, a check-in, and a fixed bedtime. But there's a late evening commitment right before that block starts, and it's easy to let it bleed into your wind-down time. Protect the transition. Action: the moment that commitment ends, go straight into your wind-down routine — don't negotiate with the clock.
